summary: Iteration 4 backend-only: offer edit/delete + application status workflow. Extended /app/backend/tests/test_scoutmoi_api.py from 54 to 69 tests. Result: 69/69 pass (100%). Prior 54 regression tests all still green (auth, profile, athletes, offers create/list, applications apply, messaging text+image, presence, read receipts, pagination, AI). New 15 tests cover: (1) PUT /api/offers/{id} owner partial update (only provided fields change, others preserved, verified via GET); (2) PUT by another recruiter -> 403; (3) PUT by player -> 403; (4) PUT unknown id -> 404; (5) PUT /api/applications/{id}/status accepted by offer recruiter -> 200, status persisted, notification message with ✅ 'acceptée' posted into athlete<->recruiter conversation, /applications/mine reflects 'accepted' for the athlete; (6) status rejected -> 200, ❌ 'retenue' notification posted; (7) status pending -> 200 with NO ✅/❌ notification appended; (8) invalid status -> 400; (9) status by non-owner recruiter -> 403; (10) status by athlete -> 403; (11) status unknown app id -> 404; (12) DELETE by non-owner recruiter -> 403; (13) DELETE by player -> 403; (14) DELETE unknown -> 404; (15) DELETE by owner -> {ok:true}, subsequent GET offer -> 404, cascading applications gone (status update on old app id -> 404, /applications/mine no longer contains it).

minor.issue: Reverting an already-accepted/rejected application back to 'pending' silently keeps the older ✅/❌ notification in the chat — no cancel/reset notification is posted. Cosmetic; consider posting a neutral 'candidature remise en attente' notification for clarity.

Endpoint blindly reposts the accepted/rejected notification every call — a recruiter tapping 'Accepter' twice will duplicate the ✅ message. Consider making it idempotent (only post when status transitions to a new value).

Cascade deletes applications but does NOT delete or notify the athlete<->recruiter conversation/messages. Old chat threads remain accessible after the offer is gone. May be intentional (preserve history) but should be documented.

OfferUpdate treats explicit null as 'no change' (uses `v is not None` filter). Client cannot clear an optional field (image/location/position/level) by sending null; must send empty string. Consider using __fields_set__ / model_dump(exclude_unset=True) if clearing is desired.
No validation that at least one field is supplied — empty payload returns 200 with the offer unchanged. Minor; could return 400 for empty update.

action_items: Optional: make PUT /api/applications/{id}/status idempotent — only post ✅/❌ chat notification on actual transitions (avoid duplicate spam if recruiter double-taps).
Optional: post a 'remise en attente' neutral notification when status flips back to 'pending' after accepted/rejected.
Optional: switch OfferUpdate/ApplicationStatusInput filter to `model_dump(exclude_unset=True)` so clients can explicitly clear optional offer fields (image/location) by sending null.
Optional: decide policy for orphan conversations after DELETE /api/offers/{id} (keep for history vs archive) and document it.

Carry-over from iteration_1 & iteration_3 (frontend/UX): create-offer Description overlap, logout testID naming, wrap root with KeyboardProvider, migrate shadow*/pointerEvents deprecations, add limit clamp + secondary sort key to messages pagination.
critical_code_review_comments: PUT/DELETE /api/offers/{id} correctly enforce ownership by comparing offer['recruiter_id'] == user['user_id'] and return 404 before 403 for unknown ids — no existence leak on ownership check.
update_application_status uses appdoc['recruiter_id'] which is the offer's recruiter (denormalized at apply-time) — auth check is correct.
Notification message uses post_message_internal via get_or_create_conversation(recruiter_id, athlete_id) — idempotent conversation lookup, safe.
delete_offer cascade uses db.applications.delete_many({offer_id}); correct. Messages/conversation intentionally preserved.
OfferUpdate/ApplicationStatusInput correctly use partial-model pattern with Optional fields; body validated by Pydantic.
server.py is now 779 lines — exceeds the 700-line soft threshold. Consider splitting into modules (auth.py, offers.py, applications.py, chat.py, ai.py) as noted in prior iteration.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_scoutmoi_api.py (now 69 tests, chained via module-level `state` dict). Run: `EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://athlete-jobs.preview.emergentagent.com pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. Delete cascade removes applications but keeps the conversation/messages. Order-sensitive: iter4 delete-offer test MUST remain the last test — after it runs state['offer_id'] no longer exists.
